pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised its policy during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised the landslide policy for Withel.

unmatched_gold.text: Yelverton Minerals and mines inspectorate met during the later response.

pairs.gold_text: Community support was organized in Withel terraces during community recovery.
pairs.system_text: Community support activities were organized in Withel terraces.

pairs.gold_text: Damage was reported in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: The slide caused damage in Dreth and the Pellan area.

unmatched_gold.text: Ashfell slide damaged the lower road.

pairs.gold_text: The operator restored the lower road during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: The lower road was fully restored by 19 March.

unmatched_gold.text: Service was restored in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.system_text: Operations at Corvane mine were disrupted by the landslide.

unmatched_system.text: The slide damaged the lower road, interrupting traffic service.

unmatched_system.text: Officials released information about the tailings dam and pond.
